regressions.issue: The text now keeps the mem[64] update in the return-data arm of the ERC-1271 call, so mem[64] is unknown after the join, and the tail written relative to it is no longer matched: the 'Usds/invalid-permit' require became a 6-line raw-memory revert, Approval's value prints as 'mem[mem[64] len _62 - mem[64] + 32]' instead of amount, and the guard became an if/stop nest.
regressions.rule: Revert and log data are relative to their base: when '_N = mem[64]' and no write to word 64 follows, 'from mem[64] len _N - mem[64] + k' has constant offsets whatever mem[64] is, so match the Error(string) layout and forward 'mem[mem[64]] = v' into the log data even after a join that leaves mem[64] unknown.

improvements: The ERC-7201 Initializable slot prints as 0xf0c57e16...00 instead of a constant times 3600 (P1 2 -> 0); P6 1 -> 0; the ERC-1271 copy loop's bound is the computed length instead of a memory read.
notes: Reviewed by reading the whole 76-line diff (3 functions, 1 display-only). Calls and storage writes unchanged.
summary: One medium regression: permit(..., bytes) lost its 'Usds/invalid-permit' string revert and Approval's value to raw memory after the ERC-1271 call's join. The P1 slot constant is fixed.
